title: Step 6 — Problem Hypothesis / Statement
description: Craft a focused problem statement that frames the core challenge from the user's perspective. Use formats like '[User] needs [need] because [insight]'.

problem_statement.description: The full problem statement as a single sentence.

breakdown.description: Decomposition of the problem statement into its components.

user.description: Who is the user? (e.g., 'Solo technical creator')

insight.description: Why? The underlying insight or cause.

assumptions.description: Testable assumptions embedded in the hypothesis — what must be true for the problem statement to hold.
